statement.p: Evaluate \int\!\!\int\!\!\int _{\mathcal{B}} f(x,y,z) \,dV for the specified function f and \mathcal{B}:

static.solution:
[0,6]\times [8,10]\times [8,9] corresponds to the inequalities 0\le x\le 6, 8\le y\le 10, 8\le z\le 9.
We write the integral as an iterated integral in any order we choose, and evaluate the inner, middle, and outer integral one after the other.
This gives
\begin{array}{rcl} \int\!\!\int _{\mathcal{B}} x{z}^2 \,dV \amp =\amp \int_{0}^{6} \int_{8}^{10} \int_{8}^{9} x{z}^2 \,dz \,dy \,dx = \int_{0}^{6}\int_{8}^{10}\left(\int_{8}^{9}x{z}^2\,dz\right)\,dy\,dx\\ \amp =\amp \int_{0}^{6} \int_{8}^{10} \frac{x{z}^3}{3}\bigg|_{z=8}^{9}dy\,dx = \int_{0}^{6} \int_{8}^{10} \frac{x({9}^3-{8}^3)}{3} \,dy \,dx\\ \amp =\amp \int_{0}^{6}\left(\int_{8}^{10} \frac{217}{3}x \,dy\right) \,dx = \int_{0}^{6} \frac{217x}{3}y\bigg|_{y=8}^{10}\,dx\\ \amp =\amp \int_{0}^{6} \frac{2\cdot 217x}{3} \,dx = \frac{434}{3}\cdot \frac{{x}^2}{2}\bigg|_{0}^{6}\\ \amp =\amp \frac{7812}{3}= 2604 \end{array} Alternatively, we can use the form f( x,y,z )=x{z}^2=h(x)g(y)l(z) to compute the triple integral as the product:
\begin{array}{rcl} \int\!\!\int _{\mathcal{B}} xz^2 \,dV \amp =\amp \int_{0}^{6} \int_{8}^{10} \int_{8}^{9} x{z}^2 \,dz \,dy \,dx\\ \amp =\amp \left(\int_{0}^{6} x \,dx\right)\left(\int_{8}^{10} 1 \,dy\right)\left(\int_{8}^{9} {z}^2 \,dz\right)\\ \amp =\amp \left(\frac{{x}^2}{2}\bigg|_{0}^{6}\right)\left(y\bigg|_{8}^{10}\right)\left(\frac{{z}^3}{3}\bigg|_{8}^{9}\right)\\ \amp =\amp 18\cdot 2\cdot \frac{\left({9}^3-{8}^3\right)}{3}= 2604 \end{array}
